scope: Authoritative lifecycle for one bounded user approval request. No Session credential issuance, UI rendering, job control, or production deployment.

rules: approval_id is public identity, never a credential
request_attempt_id identifies one GPT access attempt
same idempotency key plus same fingerprint returns the same logical approval
same idempotency key plus different fingerprint is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

approval_ttl_seconds.rule: Must be server configuration. Do not reuse GPT 30s wait or legacy Grant TTL implicitly.

mint_fence.purpose: Reserve one approval for exactly one Session mint transaction without falsely marking it CONSUMED before commit.
rules: fence may be acquired only while state=APPROVED and server_now < expires_at
one approval has at most one active fence
different mint/session identity while fenced is rejected
fence acquisition does not equal Session mint and does not equal CONSUMED
session commit must have committed_at < approval.expires_at
finalization/readback may occur after approval.expires_at if the same fenced mint was authoritatively committed before expiry
if expiry is reached while a fence exists and commit truth is not known, state becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than EXPIRED
no second mint is allowed while fence outcome is unknown

preconditions: requester is authenticated by upstream control plane
postconditions: append-only audit event may be emitted but is not authority truth

get_request.rule: Read authoritative store and apply expiry/reconciliation gate before returning state.

list_pending.rule: Read authoritative store; expired rows cannot be returned as PENDING.

preconditions: decider is authenticated and permitted for this approval
postconditions: different decision after terminal decision is rejected

preconditions: no different active mint fence exists
postconditions: fence identity is durably bound to approval_id
state_version increments for first fence acquisition

preconditions: authoritative mint outcome is supplied or outcome is explicitly UNKNOWN
postconditions: proven commit with committed_at < expires_at -> CONSUMED
proven no-commit before expiry -> APPROVED with fence released
proven no-commit after expiry -> EXPIRED with fence released
unknown outcome -> OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and fence retained
commit at or after expires_at is not a valid approval-backed mint
one approval cannot authorize two Sessions

expire.rule: PENDING or unfenced APPROVED becomes EXPIRED when server_now >= expires_at. Fenced APPROVED with unknown mint truth becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

invalidate.rule: Explicit authority revocation or scope/target invalidation may move reusable unfenced states to INVALIDATED with reason evidence; fenced/unknown mint requires reconciliation first.

api_candidate.note: Candidate paths only. They are not claims about current VCW production endpoints.

manual_fallback.rule: Legacy Grant must not become a second primary approval authority path.
